title: Antique Brass Modern Retractable Wall Hook, 2-1/2-Inch Pull-Out, Solid Brass, Wall-Mounted, Retractable Hooks And Garment Rods, Allied Brass
description:
Need hanging space in a bathroom without a hook always sticking out? This modern retractable wall hook is a wall-mounted towel hook / robe hook / wall hook that pulls out for use and pushes back in when you want a cleaner look in Antique Brass, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces.

Highlights:
- Antique Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Coordinate your look: part of the retractable hooks and garment rods collection—designed to pair with transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
- Personalize the end cap: remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with your own cabinet knob to match existing hardware
- Wall mounting made straightforward: wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging installation for standard interior walls; all mounting hardware included

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: retractable wall hook (also works as a retractable towel hook or robe hook)
- Material: brass; solid brass construction
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 2 in x 2 in x 3.75 in
- Projection: 1 in
- Pull-out hanging space: 2-1/2 in
- Weight capacity: 15 lb
- Installation requirements: drill a 3/4 in diameter hole through drywall and three small holes around; includes toggle bolts (6/32 toggles)
- Product weight: 1 lb
- Assembly required: no
